questions.scenario: You are playing a multiplayer action game (like BGMI or Valorant). What is your role?

options.text: The Frontline Assaulter: I push forward and take direct fights.
The Defender: I hold the base and protect my teammates.
The Scout: I stay hidden, gather info on enemies, and snipe.
The Tech Support: I control the map, drones, and jam enemy signals.

questions.scenario: If you were to watch an action-thriller movie, which plot sounds the most exciting?

options.text: A massive war with tanks, fighter jets, and explosions.
A high-speed car chase where cops catch a smart bank robber.
A secret agent using disguises to steal a hidden file.
A genius sitting in a dark room stopping a global missile launch via laptop.

questions.scenario: A bully is troubling younger kids in school. How do you handle it?

options.text: Stand tall, challenge them physically, and show no fear.
Step in like a leader, warn them of rules, and make them apologize.
Quietly find out their secret or weakness and use it to stop them.
Expose their fake social media accounts or bad texts anonymously.

questions.scenario: You have to protect a 'Secret Treasure' in your house. What is your strategy?

options.text: Guard the door myself with full strength and preparation.
Set up a strict rule—nobody is allowed in that room without my permission.
Hide it in a place so unpredictable that nobody even knows it exists.
Put a smart digital lock, alarms, and a hidden camera.

questions.scenario: If you could pick a special 'Defense Superpower', what would it be?

options.text: Extreme physical strength and endless stamina.
A lie-detector sense—knowing immediately who is telling the truth.
Invisibility and the ability to walk through walls quietly.
Technopathy—controlling any computer or phone with my mind.

questions.scenario: During a massive school event with thousands of people, where are you?

options.text: Ready with the emergency team in case a physical rescue is needed.
At the gates, managing the crowd, traffic, and stopping fights.
Walking normally in the crowd, secretly keeping an eye on suspicious people.
Sitting in the control room, monitoring all the CCTV cameras.

questions.scenario: Which of these toolkits sounds the coolest to you?

options.text: Survival gear, heavy boots, camouflage jacket, and a jeep.
A uniform, a loud siren, handcuffs, and a wireless radio.
Hidden cameras, lock-picking tools, and fake ID cards.
A high-end hacking laptop with multiple black screens.

questions.scenario: What kind of 'secrets' are you best at keeping?

options.text: The final attack plan of our sports team.
Knowing who broke the rule but handling it internally.
The deepest, darkest personal secrets of my friends.
The passwords and login codes for our group accounts.

questions.scenario: Defense jobs are tough. Which of these 'boring/hard' tasks can you tolerate?

options.text: Waking up at 4 AM every day for extreme physical drills.
Standing on the road for 8 hours managing annoying people.
Sitting in a dark car alone for 10 hours just to watch someone.
Reading 10,000 lines of computer code to find one tiny virus.

questions.scenario: In your friend group, what is your ultimate title?

options.text: The Warrior (The muscle and courage).
The Guardian (The protector and rule-maker).
The Ghost (The silent observer).
The Hacker (The tech genius).
